blocks.t: How the Agency Support Program (ASP) Helps Increase Policyholder Retention

For most insurance agents, policyholder retention is a crucial indicator of business success. Studies indicate that, for agents, attracting a new customer can cost seven to nine times more than retaining an existing one.
Here are some important data points to consider:
The average retention rate in the industry is 84%.
Top agencies retention rates are at 93%-95%.
Reducing customer defections by as little as 2% per year is equivalent to cutting costs by more than 10%.
A 5% improvement in retention for 5 years will double your agency’s profit!
65% of clients who leave an agency never speak to an agent before they leave.
80% of people who spoke with an agent this year stayed.
Only 13% of your book is truly loyal.
28% of people start shopping due to perceived poor service.
One of the biggest reasons clients leave an agency is a perceived attitude of indifference. They don’t feel the love.
Customer retention, not sales volume, market share, or being a low-cost producer, is the only factor that correlates with long-term profitability.

This service is designed to create Cheerleaders for your agency. Cheerleaders act as unpaid salespeople, helping to not only directly grow your agency by word-of-mouth referrals but also by enhancing your brand reputation in the marketplace. The power of a few Cheerleaders cannot be overestimated. Most businesses, including your own were likely built on a few Cheerleaders in the beginning.
They will receive priority service during an area-wide weather emergency or disaster when other folks might have to wait weeks!

We will provide your policyholders with a free, enhanced, high-tech inspection, including when coverage is in question. blocks.t: How the Agency Support Program (ASP) Creates Cheerleaders to Increase Word-of-Mouth Referrals for New Business

It is simply a fact of being an insurance agent that policyholder retention is a crucial indicator of business success. The average retention rate in the industry is 84%. The very best agencies have retention rates of 93%-95%.

No matter how you look at it, most agencies are losing between 5% and 16% of their policyholders each year! Clearly, working on improving retention rates is extremely important but given that even the very best agencies are losing 5% of their policyholders every year, so is replacing that lost business. An agency can’t even begin to grow until it comes back to “even” in terms of replacing those lost clients from the year before. Most businesspeople would agree word-of-mouth referrals are the very best advertising there is and best of all—it’s free! Given all that, doesn’t it make sense to have systems and processes in your business designed to not just keep the policyholders you already have but stimulate more word-of-mouth referrals for new business?

blocks.t: How the Agency Support Program (ASP) Helps Agents Handle Questionable or Uncovered Losses

There is perhaps no bigger customer service challenge than dealing with questionable or uncovered claims. If a potentially serious and costly loss has occurred and there is no coverage, this can be a massively negative Moment of Truth for your insured. Instead of creating a Cheerleader, you may be creating a Terrorist!

Many times, there is no way for you, as the agent, to know whether the loss is covered or is claim worthy without seeing it for yourself. And that’s where the Agency Support Program comes in! We’ll go out and perform a free inspection and be your eyes and ears on the loss. We’ll collect the necessary information, take pictures and scans and communicate back to you so you and the policyholder can make an informed decision based on coverage and severity of the damage. This helps protect your loss ratio by helping your insureds make smart decisions about filing claims. You won’t be dinged with marginal claims and your insureds are less likely to be rated or cancelled (which can happen from just making an inquiry about a claim!)
Dealing with Rising Water, Sump Pump Failure, and Sewer Backup Damage

These types of losses have several challenging aspects. First, the Standard of Care requires a higher level of removal and replacement of affected materials as well as stringent disinfection protocols to address hazards from human waste, disease causing pathogens and toxic materials. This makes them substantially more expensive to restore than clean water damage.
Second, most standard homeowner’s policies have no (or limited) coverage for these types of losses unless the insured has purchased a rider or endorsement.
What if There is No Coverage?

It is a quirk of human nature that we rarely act until we are in crisis. This might explain why some policyholders dismiss additional riders that would be of great value should they experience the problem. Interestingly, a MetLife Insurance Literacy survey confirmed that “more than two-thirds of consumers surveyed also said they’d rather pay a higher premium than be told that a loss isn’t covered.” But what is often the reality is that insureds are so concerned about the lowest price at the time of policy purchase that they do not choose additional coverage. Many agents have forms that they ask such policyholders to sign and place in their file, knowing that if such a loss were to occur, the agent will be blamed for the lack of coverage.
How the ASP Helps Soften the Blow of Uncovered Losses

We provide a free, enhanced, high-tech inspection when losses occur. We will act as your eyes and ears on the job, providing information that will help you and the insured decide whether a loss is claimworthy or not. This inspection is presented as being provided at no charge on your behalf to highlight the value you are delivering.
We execute “planned reputation enhancement” to enhance your image with your policyholders. This takes advantage of the power of the “independent third-party endorsement”.

When we see a potentially uncovered loss (such as a sewer back-up), we will reach out to you to confirm the lack of coverage (if you haven’t already informed us). Our techs say, “It’s ultimately up to the adjuster, and we’re not adjusters, but this type of loss is typically not covered by a standard Homeowner’s Policy.”

Before they call you (with a full head of steam) we take the first punch in the gut, let them vent and give them a “shoulder to cry on”. We reinforce the fact that we are there to help them because you sent us. We explain that things are not always covered and provide alternatives.

And just before they pick up the phone, we perform a very important “service recovery” act that reinforces that you sent us. We also said good things about you, delivered the free inspection on your behalf and we’ll help them get back to normal if they want us to. We do all of this to try to serve you and your policyholder so that we can all get through this together and that you can retain their business.
Working together, your agency and our company can provide the highest levels of customer service, even in the most challenging situations.
The Agency Support Program can add powerful marketing and sales tools to your selling efforts at no cost to you! To learn about all the details of the ASP, contact:

blocks.t: How the Agency Support Program (ASP) Delivers Above & Beyond Customer Service

Disaster restoration is kind of like an unplanned remodeling project that the insured has no time to plan for and is disruptive, scary and aggravating. These kinds of projects are delicate customer service situations to say the least!

In our experience, if a claim is going to “go South” it will largely be because of poor communication. We focus on the highest levels of communication because unhappy policyholders switch agents and instead of becoming Cheerleaders helping to build your business by word-of-mouth referrals, instead become Terrorists, doing just the opposite! Because we know that our service is a reflection on you, we have a fanatical focus on what we call “Above & Beyond” customer service, focusing on communication and documentation.
“Always Informed” Communication

It is our policy to communicate with our clients based on the method and frequency they prefer. Many losses only take a few days to restore but others may take weeks or months. In these projects of longer duration, we will communicate with the policyholder daily, weekly, as needed by phone, text or email. We will also provide regular updates to your agency, so you know the exact status of the claim and have confidence knowing that we are “on it!” This also allows you to “touch” the client at the optimal times during the loss to magnify the customer service impact. There is no better time for agents to touch their insureds than during a loss!
We Collect Comprehensive Documentation in Near-Real Time

In the insurance restoration world, if it isn’t documented, it didn’t happen. That’s why we collect comprehensive documentation to tell the story of the claim. This way, any third-party can see what happened and exactly the steps that we took to restore the insured to pre-loss condition. This helps adjusters understand what was done and why and close the file more quickly and easily, reducing hassles for the policyholder.
A Powerful Moment of Truth on Your Behalf

Because of the way we document the loss, we are able to offer the policyholder a Certificate of Professional Restoration once the job is complete. This documentation has two powerful benefits to your insureds. The first is that this documentation protects the value of their home when it comes time to sell. These types of losses have to be disclosed and when potential buyers see that the damage was restored by a licensed, certified, insured professional restoration contractor instead of “Chuck in a Truck” or Uncle Bob the do-it-yourselfer, this tends to make any reservations about going forward with a purchase go away. The second benefit is that this documentation reassures them about the health and safety of their family/occupants. And we make sure you get credit for this!
The Agency Support Program can add powerful marketing and sales tools to your selling efforts at no cost to you! To learn about all the details of the ASP, contact:

PR.title: CUSTOMER POLICY REVIEW & COVERAGE RISK ASSESSMENT
PR.intro: Your agent is dedicated to providing you the very best service and protection possible by making sure your homeowner’s policy is up to date and accurate according to your unique needs. Areas of possible gaps in your coverage can be identified below. Contact your agent today to ensure your policy is up to date!
PR.s1_h: RISING WATER/SEWER BACK-UP/SUMP PUMP FAILURE COVERAGE
s1_p: Often times, a rider to protect you from losses originating from sewer back-ups, sump pump failures or septic system overflows are not included in the standard homeowner’s policy.
PR.s1_s: We Suggest: Checking with your agent to make sure you are adequately covered for rising water damage.
s2_p: Sometimes, our customers are not adequately covered in the area they live.
Based on where you live, your home might be affected by:
PR.s2_s: We Suggest: Checking with your agent about additional coverage based on the area you live in.
s3_p: Often, policyholders are not sure how much their home is covered for, how much it would cost to rebuild after a total loss and what their policy would actually pay in the event of a total loss. Additions to your home or other upgrades may have been made but your policy limits not increased. Other coverage gaps may include “Law and Ordinance” which covers costs of required upgrades to meet current building codes, Landslides/Subsidence, Expansive Soils and damage resulting from outdoor pools.
Based on where you live, your home might be affected by:
PR.s3_s: We Suggest: Discussing these issues with your agent to understand whether you are adequately covered for these significant risks.
s4_p: Many people underestimate the amount of coverage they need to cover their contents, generally described as personal possessions or items that you would take with you if you moved.
You may need additional coverage to protect a number of categories of personal property that your standard homeowner’s policy may not adequately cover.
PR.s4_s: We Suggest: Discussing your amount of contents coverage and/or coverage for specific valuable collections with your agent.
PR.s5_p: Be sure to ask your agent about saving money by bundling your coverage! (Ex: Home, Auto, Life, Business, etc.)
PR.s6_h: WHO DO YOU KNOW THAT WOULD LIKE THIS LEVEL OF SERVICE?
PR.s6_p: Many of the “Above and Beyond” services we have provided have been based on our relationship with your agent. If you have friends, family or colleagues that would appreciate these same levels of service should they have a loss, please provide their names and contact information. They will receive a “no-pressure” follow up from your agent regarding a totally different kind of insurance agent experience!

PSP.cover_h1: A NEW WAY FOR PLUMBERS TO BUILD THEIR BUSINESS

p1_secs.h: DELIVERING SERVICE YOUR CUSTOMERS CAN DEPEND ON
p1_secs.p: Discovering water, sewer or mold damage on the job can be a Moment of Truth between you and your customer. How you respond can be the difference between a happy customer and a lost opportunity. When you recommend a reliable restoration contractor to fix the problem, you’ve provided value that your customer will remember.

When you have a “go-to” restorer to call, it reflects well on you. Especially when that restorer takes every opportunity to tell your customers they made the right decision by choosing you as their plumber.

When you demonstrate to your customers that you really care by helping them solve their whole problem, you create “Cheerleaders” who will recommend you to friends and family. These unsolicited word-of-mouth referrals are the best form of advertising there is—and it’s FREE!

p2_secs.p: Even the most experienced plumbers can install defective materials or make mistakes on the job from time to time, and fixing water losses that you’re responsible for can be expensive. We help make the financial burden of these “oops” moments a lot less painful.

You need restoration work done correctly to help protect your company from downstream liability and lawsuits. Because we comprehensively document every job, you have a record showing the loss was restored to the proper Standard of Care when we’ve finished.
We’ll provide your customers with both the service they expect from someone associated with your business, and reasons for them to enthusiastically refer you.

p3_features.p: We restore losses using mitigation instead of reconstruction whenever possible. This gets customers back to normal far faster and at a lower cost.

We deliver Above and Beyond Service to help you keep your current customers and to create Cheerleaders who will go out of their way to tell friends, family and colleagues how great you are--kind of like unpaid salespeople!

p3_features.h: WE HELP YOU GROW YOUR BUSINESS
p3_features.p: At our company, restoration work is only part of our job. The other part is helping you improve customer retention, create “Cheerleaders” who refer new business, reduce restoration costs when you accidentally cause a loss and prevent downstream liability and lawsuits.
